metadata.summary: Leads IoD-Gh's Secretariat and its day-to-day work to advance director professionalism and corporate governance.
metadata.biography: Dr. Alfred Braimah is the Chief Executive Officer of the Institute of Directors-Ghana. He leads the Institute's Secretariat and supports the delivery of its work in director development, member engagement and corporate governance. Working with the Governing Council, members, partners and stakeholders, he helps guide the programmes and services through which IoD-Gh serves Ghana's director community.

metadata.summary: Leads marketing and external relations, connecting members, partners and the public with IoD-Gh programmes and initiatives.
metadata.biography: Seyram Kodzo Mankra is Head of Marketing & External Relations at the Institute of Directors-Ghana. He supports the Institute's communications, relationship-building and public engagement, helping to share its programmes, events and corporate-governance agenda. He has also served as Business Development Manager for the Institute's Centre for Corporate Governance Excellence and represented IoD-Gh in professional-development and stakeholder engagements.
